about: Talk2Tax performance budgets (PERF-014). Each budget names the feature it backs, the benchmark that measures it in CI and the conditions it holds under. A budget is only claimed as met when its benchmark passes (PERF-021); scripts/check-performance-claims.mjs checks that.

budgets.title: Common API reads (dashboard, invoice list, accounts, trial balance, income statement)
budgets.conditions: CI runner: API and MongoDB replica set on one machine; 10 organisations x 2 people, plus one organisation with 8 people working in it at once (28 people), 3 requests a second each for 20 seconds, one request in six posting an invoice. The busy organisation's own reads and postings are held to the same limits.

budgets.title: Posting an invoice (with its journal) under the same load
Opening the dashboard until its balances and monthly chart show
budgets.conditions: Production build of the web app and API on the CI runner with MongoDB; Chromium at 1440x900, no throttling; one organisation with 120 posted invoices, 40 posted bills and 20 customers over the current fiscal year; 5 timed runs after one warm-up.

budgets.title: From the dashboard to the receivables ageing it links to, until the ageing rows show
Back from the ageing to the dashboard, until its balances show
Dashboard, trial balance, income statement, balance sheet, receivables ageing and invoice list for an organisation with a year of transactions
budgets.conditions: API and MongoDB replica set on one machine (the CI runner); one organisation with 2,000 posted invoices to 200 customers and 400 posted bills dated over the current fiscal year, posted by 8 members at once; each report timed 5 times after a warm-up, one request at a time. Run by hand, scripts/volume-test.mjs defaults to 5,000 invoices and 1,000 bills, 10 runs.

budgets.title: The header search (Ctrl+K) for part of a name, number or reference, from a term matching every invoice to one matching nothing
budgets.conditions: As for reports at volume: the same organisation with 2,000 posted invoices to 200 customers and 400 posted bills; five search terms, each timed 5 times after a warm-up, one request at a time.
